elee: FYI ran the longprefill goldset overnight and saw a perplexity bump only when the autoscaler migrated traffic mid-prefill -> restore. Suspect KV-restore kernel mismatch.

morgan: can you share the run id / minimal trace?

elee: run=gold-long-2026-07-13-03, trace: nodeA snapshot -> nodeB restore. nodeA used `attn_qkv_int4_opt_v1` with rot_epoch=42; nodeB was running `attn_qkv_int4_opt_v3` rot_epoch=43.

jess: small epoch diff can shift RoPE phases especially for longprefill. how big was perf regression?

elee: ~0.9% perplexity increase on 8k contexts, localized to continuations 90-160 tokens after restore.

kai: that token window sounds like accumulated phase drift. any raw stat diffs?

elee: logs: ```
[2026-07-13 03:12:01] nodeB restore: snapshot_id=zz9y8x, kernel_hint=opt_v1, kernel_actual=opt_v3
[2026-07-13 03:12:01] nodeB: rot_epoch(snapshot)=42 rot_epoch(runtime)=43
[2026-07-13 03:12:02] nodeB: debug self_attn_qk_norm median pre=0.0019 post=0.0152
```

morgan: ugh. runtime ignored kernel_hint because routing favored opt_v3 for throughput. We need runtime to honor snapshot kernel ABI/hash.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Created INF-7502: kv-restore-kernel-affinity-failure (sev=P2).

jess: immediate mitigation: pin kernel on restore if snapshot contains `kernel_hash`/`rot_epoch` and fail-safe to CPU fallback if mismatch. Also add a short smoke continuation check after restore that asserts self_attn_qk_norm delta < 5e-3.

kai: agree. add to rollout gate: if perf-bot sees perplexity delta > 0.3% on longprefill goldset post-restore, rollback.

elee: I tried forcing `export RESTORE_KERNEL_PREFERENCE=prefer_snapshot` on nodeB and reran; drift disappeared. Repro 3/3.

morgan: can we add `kernel_hash` and `rot_epoch` to snapshot manifest and include the kernel ABI ABI-check at restore time? If mismatch -> either route to a node with matching kernel or trigger CPU-serial restore.

jess: long-term: add a compatibility matrix for all quantized kernels (opt_v1..opt_v4) describing rot_scale/rot_epoch semantics. That matrix should be consulted by autoscaler placement decisions.

kai: I'll add a test to the longflight harness: create snapshot under each kernel variant, restore under others and measure token-lag drift. This will populate the compatibility matrix.

elee: filed a tiny PR with a smoke script `tools/kv_restore_check.py` that computes QK stat diffs after restore and returns non-zero on mismatch. Attaching link: github.com/redwood/infer/pull/4312

perf-bot: [perf-bot] INF-7502 updated: status=triage, metric=longprefill_perplexity, threshold=0.3%, assignee=elee

morgan: ops short-term: add a customer-scoped flag `force_restore_kernel_affinity` so Dedicated customers can opt-in to strict restore semantics until we publish guarantees.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Feature toggle request created: restore-kernel-affinity, ticket OP-982.

jess: QA note: focus regression tests around 64k and 8k contexts where RoPE accumulation amplifies small rot_scale differences. Also include quantized int4/int8 cross-variant cases.

kai: logging TODO: include `rot_scale`, `rot_epoch`, and `kernel_hash` in every snapshot manifest and in the restore event logs.

elee: will update PR to include manifest fields and add the smoke assertion to the canary rollout hook.

morgan: good. let's block autoscaler placements that would restore snapshots to nodes with incompatible rot_epoch until we have the matrix.

jess: appreciate the quick triage. keep the run id and logs in INF-7502.

elee: update: forced setting applied to canary pool, re-run shows no drift in 5/5. leaving monitoring on 24h watch.

(ended)
